name: Bank of Qingdao Co., Ltd.
summary: Bank of Qingdao Co., Ltd. provides personal and corporate banking, and financial market services in the People's Republic of China. It operates through Corporate Banking, Retail Banking, and Financial Market Business segments. The company offers deposit and savings products; personal loans, corporate loans, Youth Easy loans; professional card services, investment and wealth management, and credit card lines; foreign exchange deposit and withdrawal services; foreign exchange settlement and sale, and foreign exchange outward and inward remittance; and agency services.
